text:
tara: Heads-up — saw a spike where EU requests got routed to us-west during probe blips. Fallback to model-compact (global) increased p99 by ~220ms for eu customers. Anyone else seen this?

jon: yep, noticed yesterday. I think the region penalty decay is too aggressive so after a brief probe fail we immediately prefer non-local endpoints, even for platinum customers.

leo: can you paste a sample routing trace?

tara: here's an anonymized trace header we captured: `x-routing-trace: region=euw2 -> penalty=1200ms -> selected=global-1/model-compact -> fallback=global-1/model-small`. Request had tier=platinum, model=redwood-7b-v2.

jon: that nails it — tier override is applied during final selection, but we only apply it against primary model families. When a variant fallback (smaller quantized) is chosen we currently skip the tier affinity check.

infra-bot: Deploy: routing-config v2.14 has a change to probe thresholds (deployed at 1769998000).

leo: propose two small changes: 1) apply tier affinity before applying variant fallback (so platinum stays in-region unless region is unhealthy for *all* compatible variants), 2) introduce a shorter probe penalty for transient TCP failures but keep a longer penalty for healthcheck-timeout type failures.

jon: agree. Also we should ensure quota accounting remains with the original region if the request was billed to a Dedicated pool — otherwise billing/usage reports mismatch. Right now fallback consumes from global pool immediately.

tara: console UX ask: product wants a clear indicator when a request experienced a variant fallback vs region failover. e.g., show `routing_reason: variant_fallback` or `routing_reason: region_degraded` in request detail so support and customers can correlate latency/quality drops.

product-ops: +1 on the console flag. We also want a new dashboard tile: `route.fallback.count by reason, tier, region` and a slow-query heatmap showing fallbacks that increased p95/p99.

jon: sketch of config change for routing service (pseudo-YAML):
```yaml
routing:
  penalty_window_ms:
    transient: 1500
    hard: 120000
  tier_affinity:
    enabled: true
    apply_before_variant_fallback: true
  quota_accounting: keep_original_region: true
  metrics: emit_fallback_reason_tag: true
```

leo: I'll open a small PR to add `apply_before_variant_fallback` and wire the metric tag. Will also add an integration test simulating quick probe flaps.

tara: can you also add an end-to-end test that asserts platinum requests don't move to global-compact unless all in-region variants fail? That caught a customer issue earlier.

leo: noted. I'll add test + a dashboard query (PromQL) prototype: `sum by(reason,tier,region) (increase(route_fallback_total[1h]))` and a p99 delta: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, reason)) - ...` (will refine).

jon: once PR is up let's canary in eu-prod with 5% traffic, enable console flags for tracing, and run workload for 3h.

tara: thanks. tagging @leo @jon to follow up. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Issue created: ENG-4723 "tier affinity + variant fallback fix" assigned to leo, due 2026-02-12.
